key_insight: Symbal detects recurring, visually triggered captioning errors in MLLM-generated image-text pairs by identifying systematic misalignments and summarizing them in natural language.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a practical auditing tool for large vision-language datasets, helping teams find critical captioning failures without needing access to the underlying MLLM.
method: Uses a structured two-stage pipeline built from off-the-shelf foundation models.
Detects systematic misalignments in vision-language datasets with MLLM-generated captions.
Produces natural-language summaries of the discovered error patterns.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on SymbalBench with 1.7 million image-text pairs across 420 datasets from natural and medical domains, where Symbal correctly identified systematic misalignments in 63.8% of datasets.
watch_item: Performance is benchmark-dependent, so real-world deployment may require careful validation across new domains, caption styles, and visual feature distributions.
paper_title: Symbal: Detecting Systematic Misalignments in Model-Generated Captions
